text:
```yaml
name: Update eslint-plugin changelog

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  update_changelog:
    name: Update changelog
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20.12.0"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Get latest tag
        id: latest_tag
        run: |
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
          echo "latest_tag=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update changelog
        run: |
          node tools/update-changelog.js ${{ steps.latest_tag.outputs.latest_tag }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update eslint-plugin-sonarjs changelog"
          title: "chore: update eslint-plugin-sonarjs changelog"
          body: "This PR updates the changelog for eslint-plugin-sonarjs based on Jira issues."
          branch: "update-changelog-${{ steps.latest_tag.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          delete-branch: true
```
